claims.text: Trích Mill, Utilitarianism, chương 2: "Actions are right in proportion as they tend to promote happiness, ... the privation of pleasure." kèm bản dịch của Logos

sources.quote: actions are right in proportion as they tend to promote happiness, wrong as they tend to produce the reverse of happiness. By happiness is intended pleasure, and the absence of pain; by unhappiness, pain, and the privation of pleasure.
